name: ACTUAL - Mission commander
orders: Command from the assembly point; authorize each phase after checking actual game state.

name: ALPHA - Checkpoint team
orders: Advance on foot to CHECKPOINT NORTH, hold and report. Then search RELAY.

name: BRAVO - Overwatch team
orders: Cover ALPHA from OVERWATCH. Use the WEST ALTERNATE if the direct route is blocked.

name: CHARLIE - Air-mobile reserve
orders: Board EAGLE passenger seats after inspection; remain reserve until called.

name: BISON 1 - Escort crew
orders: Board BISON 1 using permitted driver/gunner/passenger roles, then escort the support vehicle.

name: BISON 2 - Support crew
orders: Board BISON 2 with a driver; stage at SUPPORT HOLD and remain available for recovery.

name: ANGEL - Medic
orders: Remain at the casualty collection point. Treatment requests are conditional on an actual eligible casualty.

name: EAGLE - Pilot
orders: Crew EAGLE while parked. Flight and landing are Game Master/player operated in this build.

name: EAGLE - Co-pilot
orders: Take an appropriate available aircraft seat through a separate reviewed request or normal Game Master controls.

name: BISON 1 - Armed M1025 escort
orders: Parked initially. Drive only with its complete same-faction AI crew aboard and a conscious owned driver.

name: BISON 2 - M1025 support
orders: Parked initially. Follow the inspected vehicle route after boarding succeeds.

name: EAGLE - UH-1H transport
orders: Parked transport for CHARLIE. No COMMAND helicopter flight/autopilot order is provided.
